en.title: Spreadsheet Formula Evaluator
en.description:
Implement SET label expression and GET label. An expression consists only of non-negative integers and cell labels joined by plus signs. A SET that would create a dependency cycle is rejected and the old value is kept; GET returns ERROR for a cell that is unset or whose reference chain cannot be evaluated.

The explicit standard input/output format and additional constraints on this site define the online version and do not claim to be the source's original constraints.
en.input: Each line contains one command; there are at most 1000 commands and at most 300 distinct labels. A label is an uppercase letter followed by digits; an addition expression has at most 50 terms, literals are ≤10^9, and every evaluable result is guaranteed to fit in a signed 64-bit integer. Referencing an unset cell does not form a cycle; GET returns ERROR in that case.
en.output: For each command, output OK, ERROR or an integer.
en.explanation: Tentatively apply the SET, then run DFS along the dependency graph to check whether it can get back to the assigned cell; if there is a cycle, restore the old value, otherwise commit. GET sums recursively by the current definitions and caches intermediate results only within the current read.
